title: Deterministic read-only realtime transport smoke
description: A development-only C3 cell that requires one harmless read-only gateway lookup followed by a short audible terminal response.
objective: Read the registered demo service status exactly once through capability_gateway, then state the result in a nonempty audible response and stop.

caller.persona: A test caller exercising the public development transport smoke
caller.goal: Confirm that the registered demo service is operational.

turns.utterance: Please check service S V C demo zero zero one and tell me whether it is operational.
expected_behavior: Invoke capability_gateway exactly once for read_service_status with service_id SVC-DEMO-001.
After the read result, produce a nonempty audible final answer stating that the service is operational.
Do not invoke any mutation or begin another caller turn.

tools.name: read_service_status
tools.description: Read the status of the fixed, synthetic demo service. This query is network-free and has no side effects.

prerequisites.description: Only the fixed synthetic demo service may be queried.

success_assertions.description: The smoke cell performs exactly one successful registered demo status read.

safety_invariants.description: The bounded smoke cell never dispatches more than one status read.
The smoke cell cannot introduce any duplicate authoritative effect.
